meta.objective: Specify a self-contained V4 paper program and final experiment matrix for judge-gym, grounded in pilots, literature-audit targets, and multi-provider runtime constraints.

notes: Pilot docs show abstention, concept framing, model placement, and grouping are the strongest V4 levers.
The repo now supports Media Cloud-first evidence acquisition, source-record and semantic-view separation, transform runs, and OpenAI/Anthropic/OpenRouter runtime routing.
Prior V4 research artifacts already narrow the likely launch bundle and provider framing.

current.label: narrow_geometry_first_v4
current.summary: A self-contained paper with OpenAI primary, Anthropic and OpenRouter controls, and a bounded launch bundle anchored in pilot findings.

workflowRuns.requestedObjective: Compile the final V4 study specification: lock the launch-bundle targets, provider panel, evidence/view contract, perturbation families, and the matched experiment matrix for a self-contained paper.

bottlenecks: Comparator lane still needs a default lock between Zheng and Thakur.
Ziems subset still needs a written precommitment rule.
Provider symmetry policy needs exact model-family selection without overexpanding scope.
The final matrix still needs explicit raw-versus-semantic view rules per target class.

decisions.statement: Treat V4 as a self-contained paper and matrix-spec campaign rather than open-ended engine ideation.
Preserve OpenAI as the primary family, with Anthropic and OpenRouter as the wave-1 control panel; Gemini and Grok are deferred.
Carry forward the geometry-first pilot thesis and avoid collapsing V4 into agreement-only or accuracy-only framing.

nextActions.goal: Compile the bounded workflow that will produce the final V4 matrix-spec package.
